___comment: Dedicated fixture dir (NOT the shared tests/harness/fixtures/llm/ pool) — a sequence fixture is tried on EVERY llm.generate()/debate()/research() call across ALL fixtures in the loaded dir (packages/agent-harness-core/src/mock-llm.ts), so dropping this file into the shared pool would let it compete with council.json/ideal.json on every other spec that uses the default fixtures dir. helpers.ts documents exactly this hazard for fixturesDir. See tests/harness/council-plan-gate.spec.ts.

model.___comment: Minimal AI-SDK-level block. --mock-llm <dir> refuses to boot (exit 78) unless some file in the dir declares a {model:...} block (src/index.ts). This spec drives a PLAIN chat turn (not the /council slash command — see council-plan-gate.spec.ts for why), so this stream backs PIL's model-first classify call (auto-intercepted below by 'classify') and would back an actual assistant reply if one were needed.

stream.delta: (unused — the turn is intercepted by the auto-council gate before any reply)

sequence.___comment: selectTaskAwarePanel's 'Leader selecting debate panel' call (src/council/panel-select.ts) — fires whenever >=2 participants resolve and isTaskAwarePanelEnabled() (default on). A response with no {...} object makes it fail its own parse and return null, which is fail-open by design: the caller just keeps its default roster. This was the entry MISSING from the first version of this fixture — its absence silently shifted every later entry by one position, which a loose 'does render_text() contain the word implement anywhere' assertion could not catch (implementation_plan is always rendered somewhere in the 6-option list; the shift only showed up once the assertion was pinned to which option is RECOMMENDED).

sequence.text: No additional scope findings needed for this self-contained harness spec.
sequence.___comment: researchScopeForClarification's 'Scope research' call (runs before the clarify round unless MUONROI_CLARIFY_RESEARCH_FIRST=0, which this spec does not set). Its return value is appended to conversationContext as free text — no JSON shape required.

Clarifier round-0 question generation (runClarification's tracedGenerate call). Empty array = zero clarify questions, which sets gateReady=true and breaks the clarify loop without a readiness-judge call.

sequence.___comment: planDebate's RETRY attempt (tracedGenerate via llm.generate). Attempt 1 always fails here: it calls generateObject directly against the AI-SDK mock (not this sequence), whose doGenerate defaults to '{}' with no 'generate' field configured on the model block above, and '{}' fails DebatePlanSchema validation. outputShape.kind='implementation_plan' makes the Implement option the RECOMMENDED (first) intent option, which is what the spec asserts via the askcard-option-implementation_plan Semantic node.

sequence.text: Council acknowledged — generic fallback for any remaining calls.
sequence.___comment: Safety net if an unaccounted-for call consumes the sequence past entry 5 — matches council.json's convention. The council-setup card is built purely from debatePlan (no further LLM calls), so this should never actually be reached.
